decision.letter: E. NO SINGLE MECHANISM IDENTIFIED; FURTHER PHYSICAL MODEL IS REQUIRED
decision.dominant_mechanism: numerical / GWL OP of the coupled fabric (one F12 vector at default reltol; not promoted)
decision.reason: Isolated N=32 max residual 0.66 uV. Fabric default-reltol MAE 1.014e-3 is one vector at 2.29 mV (11/12 vectors ~0.73 uV). Same topology reltol=1e-6: residual 0.73 uV, MAE 5.10e-4. Dest buffer failed. Independent supplies unchanged. Do not promote reltol.
decision.remaining_ideal: TIA VCVS, ReLU B-source, stimulus sources.
decision.limitations: Not silicon. Not a PDK. Solver-tolerance changes are diagnostic only and do not promote a pass. A LEVEL 2 dest buffer is not a physical primitive.
decision.next: Document a trustworthy coupled-GWL OP policy or install a PDK. Do not search another amplifier. Do not invent MOS. Do not promote reltol.
